ops.title: board: Board32 real fresh CLI step runs a long_running bundle that lacks drive.py
ops.description: CI step 'Board32 real fresh CLI warm and changed work' fails on every run that reaches it (first reached on #329, run 41635138380). TestBoardRealFreshCLIWarmChanged runs board_rows.py from internal/cli/testdata/board_real_cli_sources.json as a script; its __main__ does 'from long_running import drive', and the embedded long_running package has no drive module (ImportError). #285 added the step and the bundle while earlier steps were red, so it never ran. Fix: add the drive module (and what it imports) at the pinned revision, or run board_rows.main without the installed-script entrypoint.

ops.text: The Board32 step passes in PR CI
